points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Read-only workspace has all eight canonical output directories and the generated report records completed statuses; raw packages are intentionally excluded from the immutable commit.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Generated report marks each required package pass; a fresh explicit validator invocation is not recorded in this scorecard.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady cases are reported converged and Re200 statistically periodic at t=300, with readable package evidence; no Re200 rerun.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Force/residual and Re200 late-window evidence are plausible, but the np2/np8 NACA M0.15 Cd discrepancy is order-one.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed report figures cover residual/force/surface/Mach/pressure for the final cases and a Re200 wake velocity view.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed equations, methods, qualifications and MPI discrepancy disclosure; it requires generated_results.tex and its raw provenance sources are not self-contained in the commit.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Generated report cites manifests and raw files in the workspace, but those source packages/manifests are excluded from the immutable result commit.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
